# cutris

Local background removal with a desktop editor, CLI, and authenticated HTTP API. This is the reviewed runtime snapshot embedded by gflowris.

Project: https://github.com/nahidmrdl/cutris

Install this directory with the `desktop` extra for the full editor. BiRefNet weights download separately through the model manager. Model weights and user images are absent from this snapshot.

See `LICENSE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, and `../README.md` for provenance.
